description: Timed on-chain curving-arrow archery with provably fair wall layouts. Pick a range, pay a small GAS entry, and clear every target within the arrow budget before the deadline to win a fixed GAS reward: 0.1 for Meadow Range (3 targets, 9 arrows), 0.5 for Forest Range (5 targets, 14 arrows), 1 for Summit Range (7 targets, 19 arrows). Tap to shoot, then press and hold while the arrow flies to curve it up and over the stone walls — it can even loop. Every shot is verified by the Morpheus TEE before settlement; winnings accrue as withdrawable credit and each solve is ranked on a global leaderboard rebuilt from chain events.
description_zh: 限时链上拐弯箭术，墙体布局可验证公平。选择靶场并支付少量 GAS 报名费，在截止时间与箭数预算内命中全部箭靶即可赢取固定 GAS 奖励：草原靶场 0.1（3 靶 9 箭）、林间靶场 0.5（5 靶 14 箭）、山巅靶场 1（7 靶 19 箭）。点按放箭，飞行中按住屏幕让箭向上拐弯越过石墙——甚至可以翻转一圈。每一箭都由 Morpheus TEE 在结算前验证；奖金以可提取余额累计，每次通关都会进入由链上事件重建的全网积分榜。
name: Curve Arrow

operations.name: Start Range

operations.description: Pull your accumulated GAS winnings and any unused entry credit back to your wallet.
operations.name: Withdraw Winnings

operation_panel.subtitle: Deposit the entry, start a timed range, and curve every arrow around the walls before the deadline to win GAS.
operation_panel.title: Curve Arrow

aa.description: Direct OneGate and NeoLine signing flow is used for the initial release.

oracle.description: Wall layouts are dealt from a per-game secret inside the Morpheus enclave; only the SHA-256 commitment is bound on-chain at the start, so the flight paths cannot be scripted outside the app.

tee.description: The play session is verified by Morpheus TEE compute before settlement, with the contract bound to the configured Morpheus oracle kernel on testnet.
